answers.core: It can't be done in an add-on.
answers.workaround:
For my 4th point in my description of problem you can do like that:
```
var data = rd.buffer_get_data(storage_buffer)
print("size:" + str(data.size()))
for i in range(0, data.size() / 4):
	print("data[" + str(i) + "]:" + str(data.decode_s32(i*4)))
```
